sloka: तस्यैव रथचक्रेण नीलो विष्णुरिवाहवे ।शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे निकुम्भस्य च सारथेः ।। ६.४३.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: tasyaiva rathacakreṇa nīlo viṣṇurivāhave ।śiraściccheda samare nikumbhasya ca sāratheḥ ।। 6.43.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Dwivida whose body was like a thunderbolt to feel, moved about on the mountain peak as Rakshasas were watching.
